caused, secured, delivered, authored, advanced, or materially contributed to a concrete governmental action, policy, funding award, institutional benefit, or other favorable outcome.","clarification":"Code as credit-claiming when the release links the senator to a specific accomplishment or tangible progress, such as securing appropriations or grants, obtaining an agency Claims can be shared with other legislators and need not say the senator acted alone.
